title: A warning sign plus a hard limit
story: ShopBot wants to pay INR 6,000 for headphones at VoltHub, an electronics store. INR 6,000 is a warning sign, over Asha's INR 5,000 "ask me" amount, but electronics are outside what she allowed, which is a hard limit. The Guard blocks: the strictest answer wins, and every reason is recorded. Asha is never asked to approve something that isn't allowed anyway.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: VoltHub has a pair for INR 6,000. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The cart matches. Asking AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: mcc_allowed blocks, and step_up_threshold and merchant_new still run and step up: every enabled rule runs, and the most severe result wins. The Decision records all three reasons, so the Audit record shows the warning signs too. No Consent link is made: an approval can never widen what Asha allowed.
